{
 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "from ugme import UGME\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.rcParams[\"font.size\"] = 16\n",
    "plt.rcParams['font.family'] = 'serif'"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "dt = 1.0\n",
    "model = UGME(dt=0.1).fit_fetch(\"kineticmodel.npy\")\n",
    "assert model.check_initial_U()\n",
    "assert np.allclose(model.tpm, model.reconstruct_tpm())"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# get TPMs and corresponding Ut\n",
    "TPMs = model.tpm\n",
    "Ut = model.U\n",
    "\n",
    "# time axis\n",
    "tsteps, dim, _ = TPMs.shape\n",
    "time_axis = np.arange(0, tsteps, 1) * dt"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 850x850 with 9 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "fig = plt.figure(figsize=(8.5, 8.5))\n",
    "gs = fig.add_gridspec(nrows=dim, ncols=dim)\n",
    "num_rows = dim\n",
    "xlb = 0\n",
    "xub = tsteps\n",
    "xmb = xub//2\n",
    "\n",
    "ylb = 0\n",
    "ymb = 0.5\n",
    "yub = 1\n",
    "scale = 1\n",
    "\n",
    "for i in range(dim):\n",
    "    for j in range(dim):\n",
    "        subplot_number = num_rows * i + j + 1\n",
    "        plt.subplot(num_rows, num_rows, subplot_number)\n",
    "        #Clabel = \"$\\mathcal{C}$\" + f\"$_{i+1}$\" + f\"$_{j+1}$\"\n",
    "        plt.plot(time_axis, TPMs[:, i, j], color=\"black\",\n",
    "                 mfc=\"None\", marker=' ', markersize=8, markevery=200, ls=\"-\")\n",
    "\n",
    "        plt.xticks([])\n",
    "        plt.yticks([])\n",
    "        plt.ylim(ylb, yub)\n",
    "        plt.xlim(xlb, xub)\n",
    "        #plt.text(3000, 0.85, \"$\\mathcal{C}$\" + f\"$_{i+1}$\" + f\"$_{j+1}$\", fontsize=20)\n",
    "\n",
    "        if i == dim-1:\n",
    "            plt.xticks([xlb, xmb, xub])\n",
    "        if j == 0:\n",
    "            plt.yticks([ylb, ymb, yub])\n",
    "        if i == 5 and j == 1:\n",
    "            plt.xlabel(\"Time [ps]\", labelpad=10)\n",
    "        if i == dim-1 and j != dim-1:\n",
    "            plt.xticks([xlb, xmb])\n",
    "        #if i == 1 and j == 0:\n",
    "            #plt.ylabel(\"$\\mathcal{C}(t)$\", labelpad=10)\n",
    "        #plt.legend(loc=\"upper right\", frameon=False, borderpad=0, handlelength=1)\n",
    "\n",
    "space_param = 0.1\n",
    "plt.subplots_adjust(wspace=space_param, hspace=space_param+0.1)\n",
    "plt.text(-70, -0.35, \"Time [ps]\")\n",
    "#if 0: plt.savefig(\"figs/a2p_full_TPMS.pdf\", transparent=True, dpi=600, bbox_inches='tight')\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 850x850 with 9 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "fig = plt.figure(figsize=(8.5, 8.5))\n",
    "gs = fig.add_gridspec(nrows=dim, ncols=dim)\n",
    "num_rows = dim\n",
    "xlb = 0\n",
    "xub = tsteps\n",
    "xmb = xub//2\n",
    "\n",
    "ylb = 0\n",
    "ymb = 0.5\n",
    "yub = 1\n",
    "scale = 1\n",
    "\n",
    "for i in range(dim):\n",
    "    for j in range(dim):\n",
    "        subplot_number = num_rows * i + j + 1\n",
    "        plt.subplot(num_rows, num_rows, subplot_number)\n",
    "        plt.plot(time_axis, Ut[:, i, j], color=\"black\",\n",
    "                 mfc=\"None\", marker=' ', markersize=8, markevery=200, ls=\"-\")\n",
    "\n",
    "space_param = 0.1\n",
    "plt.subplots_adjust(wspace=space_param, hspace=space_param+0.1)\n",
    "#plt.text(-70, -0.35, \"Time [ps]\")\n",
    "#if 0: plt.savefig(\"figs/a2p_full_TPMS.pdf\", transparent=True, dpi=600, bbox_inches='tight')\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "tR_list = np.arange(1, 1000, 20)\n",
    "rmses = model.scan_rmse(tR_list)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 566.667x425 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.5/1.5, 8.5/2))\n",
    "plt.plot(tR_list*dt, rmses, c=\"black\")\n",
    "plt.ylabel(\"RMSE\")\n",
    "plt.xlabel(r\"$\\tau_R$ [Steps]\")\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "tr_list    = np.arange(0, 40)\n",
    "tauR_list  = np.arange(1, min(40, model.n_steps))\n",
    "\n",
    "# initialize grid with nans, so that they don't appear in triangle heat map\n",
    "rmse_grid = np.full((tr_list.size, tauR_list.size), np.nan)\n",
    "for i, t_r in enumerate(tr_list):\n",
    "    for j, tau_R in enumerate(tauR_list):\n",
    "        if tau_R > t_r:\n",
    "            rmse_grid[i, j] = model.rmse_averaged(int(t_r), int(tau_R))"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 12,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 566.667x425 with 2 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.5/1.5, 8.5/2))\n",
    "\n",
    "im = ax.imshow(\n",
    "    rmse_grid,\n",
    "    origin=\"lower\",\n",
    "    aspect=\"auto\",\n",
    "    cmap=\"Spectral_r\",\n",
    "    extent=[tauR_list[0]*dt, tauR_list[-1]*dt,\n",
    "            tr_list[0]*dt,   tr_list[-1]*dt],\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "ax.set_xlabel(r\"$\\tau_R$ (offset) [Steps]\")\n",
    "ax.set_ylabel(r\"t$_r$ (onset) [Steps]\")\n",
    "cbar = fig.colorbar(im, ax=ax)\n",
    "cbar.set_label('RMSE', rotation=-90, labelpad=20)\n",
    "fig.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 13,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 566.667x425 with 2 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# same thing with log norm\n",
    "from matplotlib.colors import LogNorm \n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.5/1.5, 8.5/2))\n",
    "\n",
    "im = ax.imshow(\n",
    "    rmse_grid,\n",
    "    origin=\"lower\",\n",
    "    aspect=\"auto\",\n",
    "    cmap=\"Spectral_r\",\n",
    "    norm=LogNorm(vmin=np.nanmin(rmse_grid), vmax=np.nanmax(rmse_grid)),\n",
    "    extent=[tauR_list[0]*dt, tauR_list[-1]*dt,\n",
    "            tr_list[0]*dt,   tr_list[-1]*dt],\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "ax.set_xlabel(r\"$\\tau_R$ [Steps]\")\n",
    "ax.set_ylabel(r\"t$_r$ [Steps]\")\n",
    "cbar = fig.colorbar(im, ax=ax)\n",
    "cbar.set_label('RMSE', rotation=-90, labelpad=20)\n",
    "fig.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Show what U(t) looks like"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 14,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "1.0178760956069426e-07\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "tau_R = 800\n",
    "prediction = model.predict(tau_R)\n",
    "print(model.rmse(tau_R))\n",
    "\n",
    "U_inf = model.U[tau_R]\n",
    "U_with_tau_R = model.U.copy()\n",
    "U_with_tau_R[tau_R:] = U_inf"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 15,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 850x850 with 9 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "fig = plt.figure(figsize=(8.5, 8.5))\n",
    "gs = fig.add_gridspec(nrows=dim, ncols=dim)\n",
    "space_param = 0.25\n",
    "num_rows = dim\n",
    "xlb = 0\n",
    "xub = 50\n",
    "xmb = xub//2\n",
    "\n",
    "ylb = 0\n",
    "ymb = 0.5\n",
    "yub = 1\n",
    "scale = 1\n",
    "\n",
    "for i in range(dim):\n",
    "    for j in range(dim):\n",
    "        subplot_number = num_rows * i + j + 1\n",
    "        plt.subplot(num_rows, num_rows, subplot_number)\n",
    "        plt.plot(time_axis, Ut[:, i, j], color=\"purple\", ls=\"-\", alpha=0.5, lw=3)\n",
    "        plt.plot(time_axis[tau_R:], U_with_tau_R[tau_R:, i, j], color=\"black\", ls=\"-\", alpha=1, lw=2)\n",
    "        plt.axvline(tau_R * dt, color=\"gray\", ls=\":\", lw=1)\n",
    "\n",
    "space_param = 0.1\n",
    "plt.subplots_adjust(wspace=space_param, hspace=space_param+0.1)\n",
    "#plt.text(-70, -0.35, \"Time [ps]\")\n",
    "#if 0: plt.savefig(\"figs/a2p_full_TPMS.pdf\", transparent=True, dpi=600, bbox_inches='tight')\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 16,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {

   ],
   "source": [
    "tau_R = 800\n",
    "pred = model.predict(tau_R)\n",
    "ref  = model.tpm\n",
    "\n",
    "space_param = 0.25\n",
    "fig, axes = plt.subplots(dim, dim, figsize=(8.5, 8.5), sharex=True)\n",
    "plt.subplots_adjust(wspace=space_param, hspace=space_param+0.1)\n",
    "for i in range(dim):\n",
    "    for j in range(dim):\n",
    "        ax = axes[i, j]\n",
    "        ax.plot(time_axis[:ref.shape[0]], ref[:, i, j], \"black\",lw=2, label=\"MD\")\n",
    "        ax.plot(time_axis, pred[:, i, j], \"firebrick\", lw=2, ls=\"--\", label=\"UGME\")\n",
    "        ax.axvline(tau_R * dt, color=\"gray\", ls=\":\", lw=1)\n",
    "        ax.set_ylim(-0.05, 1.05)\n",
    "axes[dim-1, dim-1].legend(fontsize=12, frameon=False, loc=\"lower right\")\n",
    "\n",
    "#fig.suptitle(rf\"U-GME prediction at $\\tau_R$ = {tau_R}\")\n",
    "fig.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
